title: Layer Properties of d Alpha
body_html:
Layer Properties of d Alpha

The linear maps \(d\alpha\) and \(d\alpha^\perp\) induced by conjugation with \(w\) satisfy:

  • \(d\alpha\) maps the source Moy-Prasad lattice in each Levi layer into the corresponding target lattice.
  • \(d\alpha^\perp\) lands in deeper target endomorphism lattices.
  • On the relevant graded pieces, \(d\alpha\) is an isomorphism.
  • Orthogonal complements for the Levi sequence are carried to orthogonal complements on the target side.
proof_html: Writing \(wXw^{-1}=d\alpha(X)+d\alpha^\perp(X)\), the lattice estimates follow from \(L'_t=wL_{t+s}\) and commutator identities with the transported good factors. Injectivity on graded pieces follows because the complementary term is deeper; surjectivity follows by symmetric dimension counting.
